memories.value: This project uses a repo-level venv at .venv (Python 3.14) containing fastapi, uvicorn[standard], pytest, httpx and playwright==1.62.0. Run the backend with '.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000' from backend/, and tests with 'cd backend && ../.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest'.

The frontend dev server is pinned to http://127.0.0.1:5273 (strictPort, host 127.0.0.1) because 127.0.0.1:5173 is already used by an unrelated project (H:\AiAgentTest_crew) on this machine. On the default port Vite binds IPv6-only and 127.0.0.1:5173 serves the wrong application.

Playwright is pinned to 1.62.0 in .venv so it shares the browser builds already installed at C:\Users\LIN\AppData\Local\ms-playwright (chromium-1234). Headed Chromium launches successfully in this environment; do NOT install a different Playwright version without reinstalling browsers.

The backend suite is 'cd backend && ../.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest' (840 tests, ~225s; the browser files launch a real headed Chromium). Split it when a single command must stay short: the four browser files (test_browser_driver, test_web_chat_provider, test_agent_browser_integration, test_recovery_browser) take ~107s, everything else ~116s. pytest's summary line only survives when output is redirected to a file rather than piped to grep.

The project is tracked at https://github.com/xiaoLin12130/coding-agent.git on branch main. Push with 'git push origin main' (Windows git 2.54 with Git Credential Manager 2.7.3, stored account xiaoLin12130). A stray empty clone of this same repo exists at ./coding-agent/ - it is untracked and breaks 'git add -A'; prefer explicit paths or delete that directory.

Evaluation (M9) is offline and cheap: 'cd backend && ../.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m app.evaluation.cli run' gates 50 golden parser cases and 15 agent scenarios (six dimensions) through the real stack in ~4s, writes runs/evaluation/<stamp>/ and exits 1 on any threshold miss. Cases carry their contract; a known limitation lives in the case's known_gap field and tests/test_evaluation_regression.py asserts it is unchanged - so fixing one requires updating the dataset.

Model providers are adapters in backend/app/providers (browser | scripted | openai_compatible) selected by provider.adapter in state/settings.json; the AgentLoop only ever sees a ModelClient, so a new provider is an adapter plus a registration. Secret options never persist (they come from the environment). Inspect with 'python -m app.providers.cli list|show|check'.

Real web LLM testing happens through the shipped profile deepseek-web (chat.deepseek.com): composer = textarea, answer body = div.ds-assistant-message-main-content, thinking switch = div.ds-toggle-button with aria-pressed='true' when ON (switched on automatically). The logged-in session lives in the repo's .browser-profile, so log in once by hand with 'python -m app.browser.cli login --profile deepseek-web'. Manual checks: tests/manual/live_deepseek_check.py (two questions, one conversation) and tests/manual/live_browser_agent_check.py (whole stack, real tool call).
